nodes.label: Figures as Interfaces: Toward LLM-Native Artifacts for Scientific Discovery
nodes.author: Yifang Wang et al.

nodes.label: Nexus (LLM-native figure prototype, Planner/Executor/Evaluator)
nodes.rationale: Represents a figure as a bidirectionally-mapped four-part object (visualization, data, code, metadata) so an LLM agent can trace a chart back to its source rather than treating figures as dead-end images.
